summary: Scientific Industries, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 2, 2026, reporting entry into material definitive agreements on October 1, 2026, namely employment arrangements. The company entered a new employment agreement with CFO Zachary Rovinsky through September 30, 2028, at a $210,000 annual salary plus bonus up to 10%, subject to 3.0% annual increases. It also extended CEO Helena Santos's agreement through September 30, 2027, at $200,000, and Chairman John A. Moore's subsidiary agreement through the same date, at $165,000. These are routine executive compensation contracts, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply. Watch for any subsequent strategic actions.
